items.ai_product: Thermal Dynamics Stak Pak 70A Plasma Cutter
items.title: Thermal dynamic stqk pak 70A
items.ai_notes: [Thermal Dynamics Stak Pak 70A Plasma Cutter] Industrial plasma cutter; heavy-duty equipment.
items.description:
The Thermal Dynamics Stak Pak 70A Model is a highly durable, industrial-grade plasma cutting and gouging system known for its robust construction, multi-gas capability, and heavy-duty metal removal performance. It is designed for high-precision cutting on a variety of conductive metals.
Core Features & Specifications:
Cutting Capacity: Capable of severing materials up to 1.5" to 2.75" thick, with a genuine pierce and cut rating typically around 1" thick.
Multi-Gas Capability: Can utilize multiple gas types (such as air, nitrogen, or argon-hydrogen) to optimize cut quality and speed on both ferrous and non-ferrous metals.
Auto-Switching Input Power: Often features multi-voltage auto-sensing, allowing the unit to toggle between single-phase and three-phase power inputs across common voltages (e.g., 230V or 460V).
Gouging and Scarfing: Exceptional material removal rates that make it ideal for weld removal, heavy gouging, and beveling.
Duty Cycle: Industrial-level duty cycles (e.g., 70% duty at 70 Amps max output), preventing overheating during heavy production use.
Common Applications:
Because of its raw power and rugged design, the Stak Pak is routinely utilized in heavy fabrication, railroad maintenance, scrap processing, shipbuilding, and commercial welding operations.
Comes with OEM Torch, ground cable, NEMA 14-50A to NEMA 6-50A Adapter, $150 La-Man Model 520 Extractor/Dryer, & Extra Consumables.
Runs on single or 3 phase power!
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to own a serious industrial grade professional plasma cutter for $600.00.  A single 6040 power module by itself sells for $700-$850 with no accessories.

As the most influential band in music history, The Beatles is a property that people old and young can instantly recognize. To celebrate such an incredible legacy, Stern Pinball has created the first and only Beatles-themed pinball machine: The Beatles – Beatlemania.  Rated 8 out of 10 on Pinside.
Based upon a classic 1980 Stern pinball table called Seawitch, that older table has been completely re-themed to focus on The Beatles when they began their international “British Invasion” in 1964. The likenesses of John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr (the “Fab Four”) from this era are found on the cabinet, sporting their iconic blue suits. As the game layout is essentially the same as a classic game, this title feels like it came from the 1960’s, playing as a simple game that people of any skillset can enjoy.
The Beatles does more than just re-themes an old game with new artwork however. All of the electronics are modern, with Stern’s SPIKE-2 system managing the components; lights replaced with long-lasting LEDs; a sharp HD display built into the back box for vibrant animations and remastered clips and more. Custom speech has been provided for the game by the legendary disc jockey Cousin Brucie, who introduced The Beatles at New York’s Shea Stadium in 1964. The playfield has two new feature additions that elevate the game beyond Seawitch – first, a magnet at the top of the playfield; second, a spinning disc in the center of the playfield that looks like a vinyl record.

items.description:
Mid-Century Custom 20-Watt Tube Amplifier Chassis
Featuring Premium Stancor HF-67 High-Fidelity Output Iron
This is an exceptional piece of mid-century audio history: a custom, hand-wired 20-watt push-pull tube amplifier chassis. This unit was a personal project built by a professional electrical engineer based out of Los Angeles, California.
The layout underneath is an absolute masterclass in clean, point-to-point vintage engineering. Every lead dress, ground scheme, and component placement reflects the meticulous eye of a trained engineer. It is an untouched, pristine time capsule for potential use as premium boutique hi-fi restoration or an elite guitar amp conversion (perfect for a custom boutique studio amp)
The real highlight of this build is the legendary Stancor HF-67 high-fidelity output transformer. Highly sought after by audiophiles worldwide for its incredible flat frequency response and pristine harmonic depth, this iron is rated for a clean 20 watts of power. It is entirely original to the build, structurally immaculate, and features untouched factory leads.
Bench Test Results & Technical Data
Chassis was safely evaluated on the bench using a Dim Bulb Tester (DBT) and an analog tube tester.
*Power Transformer (DBT Idle Test): PASSED. Tested with all tubes removed on a Dim Bulb Tester. It idles beautifully, safely, and quietly with zero internal shorts or catastrophic faults.
*High-Voltage Secondary Output: PASSED. Voltage readings taken directly from the rectifier socket confirm a beautifully robust and perfectly balanced 442VAC / 445VAC to ground across the plates (894VAC plate-to-plate).
Filament Winding: The power transformer features a native 5V rectifier filament winding.
Premium Vintage American Glass Included
The chassis comes complete with its original, vintage American-made tube set. Every tube has been pulled and tested on the bench for emission with excellent, strong results:
6L6 Power Tube #1: 105

items.title: Fujifilm XF 16-55mm f/2.8 R LM WR Lens
items.ai_notes: [Fujifilm XF 16-55mm f/2.8 R LM WR Lens] High-end professional lens; mint condition.
items.description:
Minty.
From wide-angle landscapes to medium-telephoto portraiture, the FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens offers unparalleled versatility and superior image quality. This weather-resistant zoom lens boasts a constant aperture of F2.8 across its entire focal range, equivalent to 24mm at wide-angle through to 84mm at medium-telephoto.
Engineered with an advanced optical design, this lens controls various forms of aberration to deliver edge-to-edge sharpness across the entire zoom range. The inclusion of a newly-developed Nano-GI (Gradient Index) coating technology effectively inhibits ghosting and flare, producing clear, high-quality images.
Ideal for a wide range of shooting scenes, this lens covers everything from the wide-angle 24mm equivalent suitable for landscape photography, to the medium-telephoto 84mm equivalent, perfect for capturing stunning portraits.
The XF16-55mm lens is equipped with a linear motor, ensuring fast, quiet autofocusing for a comfortable shooting experience. Its weather-resistant and dust-resistant finish allows it to function in temperatures as low as -10 degrees Celsius, making it a reliable companion for the FUJIFILM X-T1 premium mirrorless camera, and other compatible models, to create a fully weather-resistant system.
In order to achieve best-in-class image quality, this fast standard zoom lens comprises 17 elements in 12 groups. This includes three aspherical lens elements to control spherical aberration and distortion, and three ED glass lens elements to reduce lateral chromatic aberration (wide-angle) and axial chromatic aberration (telephoto).
The lens also features Fujifilm's unique HT-EBC (High Transmittance Electron Beam Coating) applied to the entire lens surface, ensuring ghosting and flare are controlled for sharp, clear images. Additionally, the newly developed Nano-GI coating technology reduces ghosting and flare for diagonal incident light.
The lens also boasts nine rounded aperture blades that create a smooth, circular bokeh. Combined with an X Series camera body with Lens Modulation Optimiser (LMO) technology, the lens performance is further enhanced, producing images with edge-to-edge sharpness and a realistic three-dimensional effect, even at small apertures.
The lens also offers high-speed, quiet autofocus thanks to the Linear Motor and an Inner Focusing System. The fastest AF speed of 0.06 seconds, combined with the near-silent shutter sound, allows for discreet photography in quiet locations.
The FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens is not only high-performing but also boasts a high build quality with a metal exterior and focus and aperture rings for a refined finish. The lens mount is made from brass for improved strength. The AF+MF function enables seamless manual focusing, allowing for fine adjustments after autofocusing on the subject.
This lens is approximately 60% of the weight of a full-size system when combined with a camera body, significantly reducing the burden on the photographer and ensuring ease of use. Whether you're a professional photographer or an enthusiast, this lens is a valuable addition to your photography gear, offering high-quality images, versatility, and durability.

items.title: MCS  6604 Direct Drive Turntable  NICE!
items.ai_notes: [MCS 6604 Direct Drive Turntable] Technics-built vintage turntable.
items.description: The MCS 6604 is an excellent, highly reliable vintage entry-level turntable built by Technics (Panasonic) for JC Penney's "Modular Component Systems" house brand. Underneath its department store badge, it is essentially a rebadged Technics SL-Q200. The MCS 6604 is a sleeper vintage unit that offers exceptional value because it avoids the price premium attached to the "Technics" name while retaining the identical underlying Japanese build quality. Key Performance Features include Quartz-Locked Direct Drive: Unlike belt-driven starter tables, its direct-drive motor is regulated by a quartz oscillator. This eliminates belt decay issues and provides near-perfect speed stability with virtually non-existent wow and flutter. Semi-Automatic Operation: The table offers auto-return functionality, meaning the tonearm will automatically lift and return to its rest when the record finishes playing, protecting your stylus from unnecessary wear. P-Mount (T4P) Tonearm System: It utilizes a standard P-mount plug-in cartridge setup (originally shipping with a Technics P23 cartridge). items.title: Radio Shack MPA 250B Power Amplifier
items.ai_notes: [Radio Shack MPA 250B Power Amplifier] Vintage PA amplifier with phono stage.
items.description: The MPA-250B is highly regarded in the vintage community because it mimics the aesthetics and heavy-duty build of entry-level professional gear (like classic Crown amplifiers) without the pro-gear price tag. Key Specifications & Performance: Output Power: It pushes a healthy 125 Watts per channel into 8 ohms in standard stereo mode, or can be flipped to bridged mono mode to deliver 250 Watts into 8 ohms. Built-In Phono Stage: Unlike standard commercial PA gear, it includes a dedicated magnetic cartridge phono preamp input. This allows you to hook up a vintage turntable directly without needing a separate preamp box. Independent Controls & Utility: The faceplate features dual lighted LED power meters, left/right independent input gain adjustments, integrated EQ sliders, and an A/B speaker selector. Built-in Fan Cooling: A massive internal heat-sink and whisper-quiet fan keep the unit cool under long, continuous heavy loads. You are looking at an exceptionally versatile utility piece. If you plan to pair this with a vintage system—such as driving power-hungry vintage floor speakers or running a turntable directly into it—the built-in phono stage and raw power make it a fantastic bargain.  It also has four XLR balanced inputs for microphones. This was pulled from a church in south Kansas City during a upgrade in their AV systems. I had this unit serviced around six months ago. I purchased this primarily to satisfy an old desire to experience the best audio has to offer in my price range after reading about the benefits of tubed gear.   You can take a listen at my home if you wish.  If you do decide to buy it, I would need a cash payment.  You will need an external phone stage to use this preamplifier or have a turntable with one built in, though it is my understanding the sound of those is inferior.  The one I have is a Sutherland KC Vibe Mk2 phono stage for which I paid $900 plus tax. You can also read all about this phono stage at Upscale Audio. The Viking Model F-1 Deluge Valve is a quick opening, differential diaphragm, flood valve with one moving mechanism. The Deluge Valve is used to control water flow in Deluge and Pre-action sprinkler systems. The valve is held closed by system water pressure trapped in the priming chamber, keeping the outlet chamber and system piping dry. In fire conditions, when the releasing system operates, pressure is released from the priming chamber. The Deluge Valve clapper opens to allow water to flow into the system piping.

I purchased a vintage Delta 10" cast iron band saw to replace it.

items.description:
*** POTTED CATALPAS less than 2 Feet tall $29 EACH*** 3 foot Catalpa $39 and 4 foot Catalpa $59.  Empress Trees potted 1 foot tree $59 on the last two pictures.. PLEASE DO BRING CASH we do not carry change. I have a very limited stock on hand this year. Please check the pictures and note that the Catalpas with large leaves. The Empress tree is pictured in the middle.
The pictures of the mature trees are examples. Catalpas grow very fast!! during the Fall season the trees start to lose their leaves after they have become yellow. You can plant until the ground freezes.  I can schedule appointments to see the trees on weekdays or week ends. Thank you.
Fast Growing Shade Tree With Amazing Spring Blooms.
Related to the Royal Empress tree, the Northern Catalpa tree, Catalpa Speciosa, is also a fast growing tree with amazing spring blooms. It would be outstanding as a unique, ornamental shade tree.
Large, showy white, trumpet-shaped flowers will put on quite a show in late spring. What a site this tree becomes when the huge white flowers create a stunning contrast against the solid green background of foliage! As an added bonus, the flowers attract hummingbirds!
As a member of the Bignonia Family, it is related to Trumpet Vine, Royal Paulownia, and other species of Catalpa, all of which are known for their showy flowers. This deciduous tree is also known as Hardy Catalpa, Western Catalpa, Cigar Tree, and Catawba-Tree.
The huge, heart shaped leaves can be as big as 12 inches across! They not only help block the sun on hot summer days, but also makes the chore of raking leaves a lot easier.
Farmers introduced Northern Catalpa to Ohio in order to produce large amounts of relatively lightweight timber for fence post since the wood is very resistant to rotting. Very tolerant of tough conditions, it withstands wet, dry, alkaline soils and hot, dry environments, but prefers moist, deep soil; should be planted in sun or partial shade.
For a hardy, fast-growing shade tree with ornamental spring blooms, you can't go wrong with the Northern Catalpa. Catalpas make great dwarf trees if pruned every year, but not bonsai trees due to the large leaves.
Fishermen: Grow your own Catalpa worms (the larval stage of the catalpa sphinx moth) are plump, black-and-yellow caterpillars highly prized by anglers as premium live bait, often called "catfish candy". They are the only caterpillar species that feed on catalpa trees and are known for their voracious appetites.

items.title: Vintage Heathkit AS-101 / Altec Lansing Valencia-Style Speakers
items.ai_notes: [Heathkit AS-101 Speakers] High-end vintage audio equipment; requires a specific audiophile buyer.
items.description:
For sale is a pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers, built by the owner in 1972. These are the desirable Heathkit version of the classic Altec Lansing Valencia-style speaker, using Altec Lansing components and drivers clearly marked Altec Lansing.
The Altec Lansing Valencia is one of the classic home hi-fi speakers from the golden age of American audio. It is closely related to Altec’s legendary Voice of the Theatre speaker line, which was originally designed for powerful, clear, highly efficient theater sound. The Valencia brought much of that same horn-loaded Altec character into a furniture-grade home speaker system suitable for serious home listening.
These Heathkit AS-101 speakers deliver the classic Altec sound: open, dynamic, efficient, and very natural. They produce a large, room-filling soundstage with excellent vocal presence, strong center imaging, and a wide sense of space. Music sounds lively and effortless, especially with jazz, vocals, acoustic music, classic rock, orchestral music, and tube or solid-state amplification.
Details:
Pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers
Altec Lansing Valencia-style design
Built by the owner in 1972
Altec Lansing drivers clearly marked
8 ohm speakers
Crossovers rebuilt in 2025
Cabinets refinished in 2010
Classic horn-loaded Altec sound
Large, open soundstage
Clear vocals and strong dynamics
Excellent choice for a vintage audio system or dedicated listening room
Speakers: Altec Lansing 15 woofer, 10-1/2 pound magnet assembly.  High frequency driver, 13 ounce Alnico V magnet with 800 sectoral horn.

items.description:
High‑quality 5MP 10× optical zoom bullet PTZ camera with 4.7–47 mm lens and ~80 m IR night vision! This is a serious outdoor security camera built tough with IP66 weatherproof housing, perfect for long‑range monitoring, gates, parking lots, or business perimeters.
WHAT’S GREAT:
10× optical zoom lens – see wide view or zoom way in on details (people, plates, etc.).
5MP resolution – sharp HD picture day and night.
IR up to ~80 meters – see clearly in the dark.
IP66 rated – built for Kansas City weather (rain, heat, dust).Bullet‑style PTZ – pan, tilt, and zoom controlled remotely (no manual turning).
WHAT’S MISSING:
Camera comes without the cord / power cable (you just need the correct power cable or PoE injector).
It works perfectly; it just needs you to supply the right cord.
📱 HOW TO GET IT ON YOUR PHONE:
Connect the camera to your router (via PoE or power + Ethernet).
Download the camera’s app (often the brand’s app or a generic ONVIF app like “ONVIF Viewer” or similar).
Scan the QR code or add it manually using the camera’s IP and login info.
Once added, you’ll see live video, zoom, and PTZ controls right in the app (tap, pan, tilt, zoom from anywhere without Wi‑Fi/data).
ON A TV / MONITOR:
Plug it into a NVR over Ethernet, then connect the NVR to your TV with HDMI.
Or plug it into your router / PoE switch and watch live on phone, tablet, or computer.

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Vintage UPRR train track inclinometer] A niche historical railroad tool; no price provided in the listing.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.ai_notes: [Land clearing service] This is a service advertisement for land clearing, not a sale of a specific item.
items.description: My name is Gabe Buzzard and I have a land clearing business. We have multiple skid loaders and attachments to ensure that we can handle any job that comes our way. We do all kinds of skid loader work throughout Northern Missouri and Southern Iowa, but the majority of our time is spent removing trees and brush from CRP to keep landowners in compliance.  We also do the same for farmers in pastures, field edges, terraces, fence rows, pond dams, and waterways.  We use tree pullers so that there are no stumps or roots left behind which prevents regrowth. And we also have a high flow rotary head mulcher and a brush cutter attachment for landowners that want to go that route. The remainder of our time is spent doing dirt work, creek crossings, erosion repair, small demolition, scrap cleanup, ATV trails, food plots, and much more. We aren't part timers like a lot of the others out there. This is all that we do! We are licensed and insured and have plenty of references available upon request. items.title: JBL JRX112M pair monitors excellent
items.description: For sale a pair of JBL JRX112M monitors in excellent operational condition. Cosmetically VERY good. no rips, tears, dented grilles. No voice coil rubs cut outs NADA. 8 ohms, peak 1000w, program 500w continuous 250w. Recommended amp size 250w to 500w, we ran with Crown XLS2500 (440w at 8 ohms).
